choices.why: A true three-seater in very light grey on birch legs, it keeps the long left wall bright and airy and ties in with the light wood coffee table.
At 200x300 cm this rug is big enough to anchor the sofa, table and TV zone, and its quiet sand flatweave warms the grey floor without looking heavy.
It is the only truly light wood option, pale ash on slender legs, and it matches the sofa's birch legs and the Scandinavian look.
This low, floating off-white console blends into the white walls and keeps the room luminous, with open slots for media.
The swing-arm lamp reaches over the sofa for reading, and its slim white and silver lines fit the clean, light scheme without crowding the corner.
A pair of terracotta cushions adds the warm pop of color you asked for against the pale grey sofa.
The tall, full areca palm is a real floor plant that brings lush green beside the balcony door, and its terracotta pot echoes the cushions.
White semi-sheer linen softens the black window frame and diffuses daylight while keeping the room bright.

answer.why: Pale grey, off-white, light ash and sand tones keep this white, bright living room luminous and modern. The terracotta cushions and the green palm add warmth and color for when you have friends over.
